# kkp_cluster (Resource)

A KKP user cluster. OpenStack is the supported cloud provider for now. Worker nodes are managed separately with `kkp_machine_deployment`.

KKP only accepts in-place changes to some fields (name, labels, version, expose strategy, CNI version, proxy mode, Konnectivity, allowed IP ranges, audit logging, admission plugins, OPA, Kyverno, MLA, the Kubernetes dashboard and cloud credentials); the provider replaces the cluster when anything else changes. Upgrade the control plane one minor version at a time, and keep machine deployments within KKP's kubelet version skew.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "kkp_kubernetes_versions" "openstack" {}

resource "kkp_cluster" "staging" {
  name        = "staging"
  datacenter  = "os-zurich"
  version     = data.kkp_kubernetes_versions.openstack.default_version
  labels      = { env = "staging" }
  ssh_key_ids = [kkp_ssh_key.ops.id]

  openstack = {
    # Or set credential_preset on the cluster instead.
    application_credential_id     = var.os_application_credential_id
    application_credential_secret = var.os_application_credential_secret
  }

  # Clean up cloud resources the cluster created.
  delete_volumes_on_destroy        = true
  delete_load_balancers_on_destroy = true

  timeouts = {
    create = "20m"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `datacenter` (String) Datacenter name, see the `kkp_datacenters` data source.
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `openstack` (Attributes) OpenStack settings. Set either `credential_preset`, user credentials (`username`, `password`, `domain` and `project` or `project_id`), or an application credential. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--openstack))
- `version` (String) Kubernetes version of the control plane, e.g. `1.32.5`. See `kkp_kubernetes_versions`.

### Optional

- `admission_plugins` (Set of String) Extra admission plugins, e.g. `PodNodeSelector`.
- `api_server_allowed_ip_ranges` (List of String) CIDRs allowed to reach the API server; only enforced with the `LoadBalancer` expose strategy.
- `audit_logging` (Boolean) Enable Kubernetes audit logging.
- `audit_policy_preset` (String) Audit policy preset: `metadata`, `recommended` or `minimal`.
- `cni_type` (String) CNI plugin: `cilium`, `canal` or `none`. Defaults to KKP's choice (Cilium).
- `cni_version` (String) CNI plugin version. Defaults to KKP's default for the plugin; can be upgraded in place.
- `credential_preset` (String) Name of a KKP preset to take the cloud credentials from, instead of setting them in `openstack`.
- `delete_load_balancers_on_destroy` (Boolean) Delete the cluster's load balancers when the cluster is destroyed.
- `delete_volumes_on_destroy` (Boolean) Delete the cluster's persistent volumes when the cluster is destroyed.
- `expose_strategy` (String) How the API server is exposed: `NodePort`, `LoadBalancer` or `Tunneling`. Defaults to the seed's setting.
- `konnectivity` (Boolean) Use Konnectivity for control plane to node traffic.
- `kubernetes_dashboard` (Boolean) Deploy the Kubernetes dashboard.
- `kyverno` (Boolean) Enable Kyverno (Enterprise Edition).
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels. Labels KKP manages itself (`project-id`, `is-credential-preset`, `worker-name`) are ignored.
- `mla_logging` (Boolean) Enable user cluster logging (MLA).
- `mla_monitoring` (Boolean) Enable user cluster monitoring (MLA).
- `node_local_dns_cache` (Boolean) Run NodeLocal DNSCache on the nodes.
- `opa_integration` (Boolean) Enable the OPA Gatekeeper integration.
- `pods_cidr` (String) IPv4 pod network. Defaults to KKP's (172.25.0.0/16).
- `project_id` (String) Project ID. Defaults to the provider's `project_id`.
- `proxy_mode` (String) kube-proxy mode: `ipvs`, `iptables`, `ebpf` (Cilium only) or `nftables`.
- `services_cidr` (String) IPv4 service network. Defaults to KKP's (10.240.16.0/20).
- `ssh_key_ids` (Set of String) IDs of project SSH keys (`kkp_ssh_key.id`) to put on the nodes.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))
- `user_ssh_key_agent` (Boolean) Run KKP's user SSH key agent, which syncs `ssh_key_ids` to the nodes. Cannot be changed after creation.
- `wait_for_ready` (Boolean) Wait until the control plane is healthy after create and upgrade.

### Read-Only

- `creation_timestamp` (String)
- `id` (String) Cluster ID, generated by KKP.
- `url` (String) API server URL.

<a id="nestedatt--openstack"></a>
### Nested Schema for `openstack`

Optional:

- `application_credential_id` (String) Application credential ID. KKP stores credentials in a secret and never returns them, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.
- `application_credential_secret` (String, Sensitive) Application credential secret. KKP stores credentials in a secret and never returns them, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.
- `domain` (String) OpenStack domain. KKP stores credentials in a secret and never returns them, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.
- `floating_ip_pool` (String) External network for floating IPs. KKP picks one when unset.
- `network` (String) Existing network for the nodes. KKP creates one when unset.
- `node_ports_allowed_ip_ranges` (List of String) CIDRs allowed to reach NodePort services.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) OpenStack password. KKP stores credentials in a secret and never returns them, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.
- `project` (String) OpenStack project (tenant) name. KKP stores credentials in a secret and never returns them, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.
- `project_id` (String) OpenStack project (tenant) ID. KKP stores credentials in a secret and never returns them, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.
- `router_id` (String) Existing router. KKP creates one when unset.
- `security_groups` (String) Existing security group for the nodes. KKP creates one when unset.
- `subnet_id` (String) Existing subnet for the nodes. KKP creates one when unset.
- `username` (String) OpenStack user name. KKP stores credentials in a secret and never returns them, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.


<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Credentials are not returned by KKP: set them in the configuration again after importing.
tofu import kkp_cluster.staging <project_id>/<cluster_id>
```
